T1.implementation_approach: Set up a version control system (e.g., Git), initialize the project structure, and configure necessary tools and dependencies.
T1.notes: Ensure all team members have access to the repository.

T2.implementation_approach: Design an ER diagram and create tables for notes, users, and categories with appropriate relationships.
T2.notes: Consider scalability and indexing for performance.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop API endpoints to handle note creation, validate input, and store data in the database.
T3.notes: Use proper authentication and error handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Create API endpoints to update existing notes, ensuring only authorized users can edit.
T4.notes: Implement version control for note edits if needed.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop API endpoints to delete notes and ensure proper authorization checks.
T5.notes: Consider soft deletes for data recovery.

T6.implementation_approach: Implement API endpoints to organize notes by categories, tags, or custom user-defined structures.

T7.implementation_approach: Build a form-based UI to allow users to create notes and integrate it with the backend API.
T7.notes: Ensure a responsive design for different devices.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop a UI for editing notes, preloading existing data, and sending updates to the backend.
T8.notes: Provide a user-friendly interface for editing.

T9.implementation_approach: Create a frontend feature to delete notes with confirmation prompts and integrate it with the backend.
T9.notes: Ensure proper feedback to the user after deletion.

T10.implementation_approach: Design a drag-and-drop or filter-based UI for organizing notes and sync changes with the backend.

T11.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests for all backend endpoints using a testing framework.
T11.notes: Test edge cases and error scenarios.

T12.implementation_approach: Perform manual and automated testing for all frontend components to ensure proper functionality.
T12.notes: Test across multiple browsers and devices.

T13.implementation_approach: Deploy the application to a cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Heroku) and configure CI/CD pipelines.
T13.notes: Ensure environment variables and secrets are securely managed.
